# Communication Design Project

## Overview
This repository contains the GNU Radio Companion (`.grc`) flowgraphs and Python source scripts for our communication design project.

## Prerequisites
* GNU Radio Companion
* Python 3.x

## Repository Structure
* `*.grc`: GNU Radio flowgraph files (Primary editable files).
* `*.py`: Custom Python modules and signal processing scripts (Excludes auto-generated flowgraph scripts).

## Setup Instructions
1. Clone this repository.
2. Open the respective `.grc` file in GNU Radio Companion.
3. Generate and execute the flowgraph locally.
